# Widget loop dynamics in solution

## Introduction

> [!cite|margin llm]- References (1)
> - [[#^gam21-ref-1|1]] Alpha A, Beta B. Loop structures in widget proteins. J Widget Sci. 2020. → [[alpha2020|Alpha (2020)]]

The introduction restates that crystal surveys found a handful of loop shapes [[#^gam21-ref-1|1]]. ^gam21-p001

## Results

> [!claim|margin llm supports] Supports (model-derived)
> - [[Widget loop shapes interconvert in solution]]

> [!claim|margin llm qualifies] Qualifies
> - [[Short widget loops adopt a small number of canonical shapes]]

> [!claim|margin llm contradicts] Contradicts
> - [[Widget loops are rigid]]

<abbr title="molecular dynamics">MD</abbr> simulations of 12 loops showed <mark class="pm-claim">shapes switching within nanoseconds</mark>, so <mark class="pm-claim">a loop's shape is a population average rather than a fixed state</mark>, and <mark class="pm-claim">no loop stayed in one shape for the whole run</mark>. ^gam21-p002
